title: Excuse for Breaks
approach: A run of L ones is worth L*d + floor(L/n)*S + R(L mod n) with R the prefix sum of r over the thresholds p; whole blocks of n cancel on both sides of f(a) > f(I(a)), so the answer is YES iff two runs already beat one — swept over all O(m^2) threshold pairs.

techniques.label: prefix-sum
techniques.why: R(L mod n) is a prefix sum over the thresholds

techniques.label: brute-force
techniques.why: the O(m^2) sweep over threshold pairs
